arxiv-2204-12808.title: A Method of Query Graph Reranking for Knowledge Base Question Answering
arxiv-2204-12808.creator: Yonghui Jia, Wenliang Chen
arxiv-2204-12808.description: Abstract This paper presents a novel reranking method to better choose the optimal query graph, a sub-graph of knowledge graph, to retrieve the answer for an input question in Knowledge Base Question Answering (KBQA). Existing methods suffer from a severe problem that there is a significant gap between top-1 performance and the oracle score of top-n results.

arxiv-2307-15991.title: Separate Scene Text Detector for Unseen Scripts is Not All You Need
arxiv-2307-15991.creator: Prateek Keserwani, Taveena Lotey, Rohit Keshari, Partha Pratim Roy
arxiv-2307-15991.description: Abstract Text detection in the wild is a well-known problem that becomes more challenging while handling multiple scripts. In the last decade, some scripts have gained the attention of the research community and achieved good detection performance. However, many scripts are low-resourced for training deep learning-based scene text detectors.

arxiv-2309-00151.title: Notes on a non-thermal fluctuation-dissipation relation in quantum Brownian motion
arxiv-2309-00151.creator: Xinyi Chen-Lin
arxiv-2309-00151.description: Abstract 1 Introduction The Schwinger-Keldysh (SK) formalism [ 1 , 2 ] is a well-known path integral framework to study quantum non-equilibrium many-body systems [ 3 ] . In the classical limit, it reduces to the Martin-Siggia-Rose (MSR) path integral, which is also equivalent to the stochastic Langevin description.

The proliferation of mobile applications and the subsequent sharing of personal data with service and application providers have given rise to substantial privacy concerns. Application marketplaces have introduced mechanisms to conform to regulations and provide individuals with control over their data.

arxiv-2412-07153.title: t-Product and t-STP of Cubic Matrices with an Application to Hyper-Networked Systems
arxiv-2412-07153.creator: Daizhan Cheng, Zhengping Ji
arxiv-2412-07153.description: Abstract Control systems with tensor-valued state transitions require a product that specifies both how coefficients act on each frontal slice and how different slices interact. This paper develops a t-semi-tensor product (t-STP) on cubic matrices that retains the circular coupling of the t-product while allowing rectangular coefficient slices to act on a fixed state space.

arxiv-2504-15136.title: 𝕃 p \mathbb{L}^{p} -solutions ( 1 < p < 2 ) (1<p<2) for reflected BSDEs with general jumps and stochastic monotone generators
arxiv-2504-15136.creator: Badr Elmansouri, Mohamed El Otmani, Mohamed Marzougue
arxiv-2504-15136.description: Abstract We consider a one-reflected backward stochastic differential equation with a general RCLL barrier in a filtration that supports a Brownian motion and an independent Poisson random measure. We establish the existence and uniqueness of a solution in 𝕃 p \mathbb{L}^{p} for p ∈ ( 1 , 2 ) p\in(1,2) .

arxiv-2509-06410.title: Verifying Sampling Algorithms via Distributional Invariants
arxiv-2509-06410.creator: Kevin Batz, Joost-Pieter Katoen, Tobias Winkler, Daniel Zilken
arxiv-2509-06410.description: Abstract This paper develops a verification framework aimed at establishing the correctness of discrete sampling algorithms. We do so by considering probabilistic programs as distribution transformers. Inspired by recent work on distributional verification of Markov models, we introduce the notion of (inductive) distributional loop invariants for discrete probabilistic programs.

arxiv-2601-16148.title: ActionMesh: Animated 3D Mesh Generation with Temporal 3D Diffusion
arxiv-2601-16148.creator: Remy Sabathier David Novotny Niloy J. Mitra Tom Monnier
arxiv-2601-16148.description: Abstract Generating animated 3D objects is at the heart of many applications, yet most advanced works are typically difficult to apply in practice because of their limited setup, their long runtime, or their limited quality. We introduce ActionMesh, a generative model that predicts production-ready 3D meshes ‘in action’ in a feed-forward manner.

pmc-11510125.title: Application of the Thermal Analysis of Frozen Aqueous Solutions to Assess the Miscibility of Hyaluronic Acid and Polymers Used for Dissolving Microneedles
pmc-11510125.creator: Ken-ichi Izutsu, Hiroyuki Yoshida, Yasuhiro Abe, Eiichi Yamamoto, Yoji Sato, Daisuke Ando, Francisco Javier Otero-Espinar
pmc-11510125.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: The combination of multiple polymers is anticipated to serve as a means to diversify the physical properties and functionalities of dissolving microneedles. The mixing state of components is considered as a crucial factor in determining their suitability. Objectives: The purpose of this study was to elucidate whether thermal analysis of frozen aqueous solutions can appropriately predict the miscibility of hyaluronic acid (HA) and other polymers used for dissolving microneedles prepared by a micromolding method.

pmc-11547147.title: The Effect of Exercise Program Interventions on Frailty, Clinical Outcomes, and Biomarkers in Older Adults: A Systematic Review
pmc-11547147.creator: Adchara Prommaban, Sasiwimon Moonkayaow, Phichayut Phinyo, Penprapa Siviroj, Wachiranun Sirikul, Peerasak Lerttrakarnnon, Birna Bjarnason-Wehrens, Attila Nemes
pmc-11547147.description: Background: Frailty is characterized by the decreased ability in older adults to handle daily or acute stressors due to age-related declines in physiological reserve and organ system performance. This condition results from the interaction of multiple physiological pathways and changes in biomarkers. Exercise programs are currently recommended to promote “healthy aging” in frail older adults.

pmc-11606888.title: Fermented Quinoa and Canihua in Plant‐Based Diets Increase Iron and Zinc Bioavailability in Growing Rats
pmc-11606888.creator: Vanesa Castro‐Alba, Mirian Vargas, Ann‐Sofie Sandberg, Daysi Perez‐Rea, Björn Bergenståhl, Yvonne Granfeldt, Claudia E. Lazarte
pmc-11606888.description: This study aimed at evaluating the effects of non‐fermented and fermented pseudocereal flours, quinoa and canihua, on iron and zinc bioavailability in Wistar rats. Two diets prepared with 92% fermented quinoa or 79.5% fermented canihua were compared with diets prepared with the same amount of non‐fermented pseudocereals.

pmc-11644172.title: Does the Incorporation of Biochar into Biodegradable Mulch Films Provide Agricultural Soil Benefits?
pmc-11644172.creator: Kesinee Iamsaard, Nuttapon Khongdee, Raweerat Rukkhun, Charoon Sarin, Pantip Klomjek, Chanin Umponstira, Denis Miroshnichenko, Vladimir Lebedev
pmc-11644172.description: The pollution caused by plastic mulch film in agriculture has garnered significant attention. To safeguard the ecosystem from the detrimental effects of plastic pollution, it is imperative to investigate the use of biodegradable materials for manufacturing agricultural plastic film. Biochar has emerged as a feasible substance for the production of biodegradable mulch film (BDM), providing significant agricultural soil benefits.

pmc-12609921.title: Complementary Therapies of Diabetic Peripheral Neuropathy and Intermittent Claudication
pmc-12609921.creator: Shu Yan Ng, Carlos Ruiz-Moreno
pmc-12609921.description: Epidemiological studies have shown that the prevalence of diabetic peripheral neuropathy (DPN) will increase. Currently, DPN is treated medically. In many instances, the outcome is less than satisfactory, and the treatment is associated with side effects. We report a case of severe DPN and peripheral artery disease that are refractory to medical treatment.

pmc-12657636.title: Relationship Between Complex Signal Identification and Non‐Pulmonary Vein Foci
pmc-12657636.creator: Hiroyuki Kono, Kenichi Hiroshima, Keigo Misonou, Koumei Onuki, Maiko Kuroda, Jun Hirokami, Tomonori Katsuki, Rei Kuji, Kengo Korai, Masato Fukunaga, Michio Nagashima, Kenji Ando
pmc-12657636.description: BackgroundPulmonary vein isolation (PVI) is the cornerstone of atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation; however, recurrences often originate from non‐pulmonary vein (non‐PV) foci. The Complex Signal Identification (CSI) algorithm in CARTO 3 assigns electrogram‐fractionation scores (0–10). This study evaluated the feasibility of CSI‐assisted mapping for identifying non‐PV triggers.MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed 23 consecutive patients undergoing first‐time AF ablation between January and June 2024.
